Chapter 1039: 4: The Terrifying Fierce Sun Divine Body (Requesting Monthly Votes) _3

Chapter 1039: Chapter 4: The Terrifying Fierce Sun Divine Body (Requesting Monthly Votes) _3

Lord Qingfen vaguely felt something was amiss, but couldn’t pinpoint it.

“Better to make more preparations.”

Lord Qingfen pondered for a moment, then immediately summoned the disciples.

“Greetings, Marquis.”

Feng Wanxing and other Sovereign Realm cultivators bowed toward Lord Qingfen.

Although Lord Qingfen never allowed them to address him as Master, the treatment they received was hardly lacking.

“From now on, if I’m not in Qingfen City and the Purple Dream Domain or other major territories launch an assault, ignore other areas and focus on defending these specific locations.”

Lord Qingfen immediately listed the core arrays of Qingfen City.

In Lord Qingfen’s predictions, the worst scenario was being occupied and delayed.

Then, the Purple Dream Domain would take advantage to cause chaos and destroy the city’s arrays.

If he remained in Qingfen City? The Purple Dream Domain wouldn’t stand a chance.

As for a full-scale invasion of Qingfen City?

Even if Lord Qingfen were absent from the city, the arrays of Qingfen City would activate automatically upon attack, providing enough support for a long period.

Thus, Lord Qingfen speculated that the strong cultivators of the Purple Dream Domain might attempt to infiltrate Qingfen City in advance.

However, their numbers would certainly be limited, as Qingfen City had specialized detection formations. If the “thickness of life” of those entering exceeded a certain threshold, an alarm would be triggered.

“The so-called ‘thickness of life’ refers to the power and quantity of an entity.”

“For example, if someone at the level of a Great Venerable enters, I would immediately sense it.”

“Or if a large number of Sovereign Realm cultivators invade, I would sense that as well.”

“The strongest entities could use secret techniques to suppress their own aura, hiding their origin and background.”

“But the thickness of life cannot be altered. Should it exceed the critical threshold, I will promptly be aware.”

“Understood.”

Feng Wanxing and the other disciples responded immediately.

“Marquis, is the Purple Dream Domain planning something recently?” Feng Wanxing probed cautiously.

The layout Lord Qingfen was organizing was clearly aimed at the Purple Dream Domain.

“I am merely making preparations. Whether the Purple Dream Domain takes action or not, we’ll see when the time comes.”

Lord Qingfen replied calmly.

Deep down, he even hoped the Purple Dream Domain would make their move.

The power of the Purple Dream Great Venerable could barely match Lord Qingfen’s level, but if the two clashed, Lord Qingfen would clearly hold the upper hand.

Furthermore, Lord Qingfen recently made breakthroughs in secret technique cultivation.

If Marquis Purple Dream dared to come, Lord Qingfen was confident he could seriously injure him.

With Marquis Purple Dream severely injured, the Qingfen Domain could enjoy peace for millions, perhaps tens of millions of years.

“Dismissed.”

Lord Qingfen waved his hand.

Once all the disciples had retreated,

Lord Qingfen sank into contemplation.

“That disciple of mine has been requesting far too many resources lately.”

Lord Qingfen rubbed his chin.

Lin Yuan was his most valued disciple. Though Lord Qingfen rarely interacted with him publicly, he had been secretly observing him all along.

“Still, as long as you can bear it, resources are nothing. Go ahead and take them.”

Lord Qingfen smiled faintly, a hint of anticipation in his heart.

…

Inside the Sky Burning Court, Lin Yuan was observing the changes in his physical body.

After condensing thirty thousand Seeds of the Fierce Sun, the transformation speed of the Fierce Sun Divine Body had skyrocketed. Lin Yuan could perceive the changes in his body and physique every single moment.

“Every drop of my blood, down to the most microscopic particles, has turned crimson, evolving more intricate patterns…”

Lin Yuan’s expression carried traces of contemplation as those patterns intertwined, significantly strengthening his physical body and even resonating with the most fundamental Dadao principles of heaven and earth.

Whether in this origin world or within the Chaos Void, every cultivator seeks Dadao enlightenment to wield its principles.

This act is inherently proactive.

Yet the unfinished transformation of the Fierce Sun Divine Body now seemed to give Lin Yuan a sense of instinctive resonance with the universal Dadao principles.

He didn’t need to pursue the Dao; the Dao naturally came to him.

“Magnificent.”

The more Lin Yuan observed, the more he marveled inwardly.

Beneath the practice of body-refinement secret techniques, Lin Yuan possessed deep foundations and had mastered supreme skills like the “Xuanhuang Physique,” a Dao-protecting secret method created through the painstaking effort of a Great Saint.

Along with portions of the “Demonic Jade Immortal Body.”

However, neither the Xuanhuang Physique nor the Demonic Jade Immortal Body were anything more than methods to refine the physical form, building an indestructible existence.

The Fierce Sun Divine Body, on the other hand, reconstructed the physical form, fundamentally altering its composition. Up to now, Lin Yuan still wasn’t sure whether he remained part of the Human Race.

Of course, the defining attribute of a race wasn’t the physical form but the Primordial Spirit and True Spirit, a truth Lin Yuan had long understood during the Main Universe era of human civilization.

Many evolutionists of human civilization in the Main Universe had chosen to seize unique life forms to enhance their starting points. After seizure, their physical forms might not remain human, yet as long as their True Spirit was human, they were still considered human.

“The Fierce Sun Divine Body also has distinctions.”

“The most basic Fierce Sun Divine Body is formed from three thousand three hundred thirty-three Seeds of the Fierce Sun.”

“As the number of condensed Seeds of the Fierce Sun increases, the power of the divine body grows stronger.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

These insights were gained from Lin Yuan’s meticulous observations of his own body.

The transformation process of a Fierce Sun Divine Body created from twenty thousand Seeds of the Fierce Sun was vastly different from one created with merely three thousand Seeds.

This difference wasn’t just in transformation speed but also in the details of the composition.

“Once the Fierce Sun Divine Body is fully transformed, everything will become clear.”

Lin Yuan mused inwardly. While the transformation remained incomplete, much couldn’t yet be understood.

Time flowed slowly.

Five years passed in the blink of an eye.

Rumble.

Lin Yuan’s physical body finally completed its final transformation.

Sitting cross-legged, Lin Yuan carefully sensed the changes in his physique and physical form.

At this moment, the most microscopic elements of Lin Yuan’s body had completely transformed into particles of flame, with profoundly mysterious patterns etched upon every particle. The patterns intertwined and entangled with each other.

“This?”

Lin Yuan exhaled softly. With the transformation of the Fierce Sun Divine Body completed, an abundance of instinctual information flooded into his mind.
